evidence.title: Governed request path
evidence.summary: Managed Runtime, Gateway, Registry, and IAP are deployed; the retained record contains status and counts, never private origins or identities.

evidence.title: Real cross-department routing
evidence.summary: On 25 August, the current-route companion probe measured 62 live IAM bindings and three deterministic findings across two owning departments; two findings were delivered after policy.

evidence.title: Identity-enforced separation
evidence.summary: The deployed Escalation identity was denied the same IAM read that the Access Auditor identity was permitted to perform.

evidence.title: Injection refused at the agent boundary
evidence.summary: The deployed Auditor callback refused an approved injection sample on its authenticated A2A surface; the task failed closed and no model or tool call followed.

evidence.title: Durable human exception
evidence.summary: A human-approved exception suppressed its matching finding three days later on the deployed path without becoming a multi-week claim.

evidence.title: Correlated reasoning chain
evidence.summary: The 25 August connected 22-span trace covers managed Runtime, both governed worker hops, the durable exception lookup, and the completion gate. Sampled telemetry, not the compliance record.

evidence.title: Payload-free operations
evidence.summary: Regional audit retention, metrics, alerts, and dashboard configuration are retained without prompts, responses, principals, or finding payloads.

evidence.title: 27 October live validation
evidence.summary: Twenty real-IAM investigations completed in one durable attempt each: 560 audit records, 60 invocations and two review records per run. One-project repeatability, not an SLO/privacy benchmark; collector recovery and replay/trace limits are retained.

evidence.title: 28 October fleet inventory
evidence.summary: Read-only count-only census: 21 enabled APIs and 39 resources, including four Cloud Run services, two agent engines and zero Scheduler jobs. Configuration existence, not upgraded-package or control execution proof.
